app.name: Doctor Appointments
app.emergency: Nothing here is a diagnosis. In an emergency, go to the emergency room right away.

auth.loginSub: Book a doctor and check your place in the queue.
auth.registerSub: For patients who want to book online.
auth.consent: I agree that the hospital may store and use my health information for appointments, as described in the privacy policy.

forgot.title: Request a password reset
forgot.sub: Staff will verify your identity before approving. No email is sent.
forgot.phoneHint: Staff may call this number to confirm it is you.
forgot.noRequest: No request found in this browser. Use the same browser and device you sent the request from.
forgot.pending: Waiting for staff to verify and approve.
forgot.pendingHelp: Give this code to hospital staff when you contact them, then come back to this page in the same browser. The request expires in 24 hours.
forgot.approved: Approved. Get your temporary password within 30 minutes.
forgot.showOnce: Shown once. Write it down before leaving this page. You must set a new password right after you sign in.
forgot.rejected: This request was not approved. Contact the hospital or send a new request.
forgot.expired: This request has expired. Please send a new one.
forgot.claimed: The temporary password was already issued. Sign in with it and set a new one.

password.title: Change password
password.forcedSub: Set a new password before you continue.

home.emptyHint: Describe your symptoms, then pick a doctor and a time.
home.limit: You already have {max} upcoming visits. Cancel one or wait until a visit is over to book another.

ticket.cannotCancel: You can't cancel online within {hours} hours of the visit. Please contact staff.

book.title: Book a visit
book.reasonHint: For example: stomach pain for 3 days, itchy rash on the arm (500 characters max).
book.disclaimer: Clinic suggestions come from keywords in your text and are not a diagnosis. In an emergency, go to the emergency room right away.
book.noDoctors: No doctors in this clinic yet
book.chooseDate: Choose a day (days the doctor sees patients)
book.noSlots: No times available on this day. Try another day.
book.slotLegend: Greyed-out times are taken or too soon (book at least {hours} hours ahead).
book.queueNone: No one is ahead of you in this session.
book.queueBefore: {n} people are ahead of you in this session.
book.cancelRule: You can cancel up to {hours} hours before the visit. To reschedule, cancel and book again.

profile.title: Profile
profile.hnHint: Staff will add it when you visit the hospital.

doctor.title: My queue
doctor.noProfile: This account isn't linked to a doctor record. Contact the administrator.
doctor.empty: No patients booked for this day

staff.title: Clinic queue
staff.noClinicHint: Ask the administrator to assign your clinic.

resets.title: Patient password requests
resets.sub: Verify identity outside the system before approving.
resets.howTo: Call back the registered number and ask the patient to read out the 6-digit code, or check their ID in person. Staff never see any password.

admin.title: Overview
admin.initialHint: The user must change it at first sign-in.
admin.resetDone: Password set. The user must change it at next sign-in.
admin.resetHint: Give this password to the account owner in person, not over a public channel.
admin.slotHint: Applies to new bookings only. Existing visits are not changed.
admin.cancelHours: Minimum notice to book or cancel (hours)

errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Some of the information isn't valid. Check it and try again.
errors.VALIDATION: Some fields are missing or invalid. Check each field and try again.
errors.DOCTOR_UNAVAILABLE: The doctor isn't available at that day or time.
errors.SLOT_TAKEN: That time was just taken. Please choose another.
errors.LIMIT_REACHED: You've reached the limit of upcoming visits.
errors.TOO_LATE: That time is too soon to book.
errors.TOO_FAR: That date is further ahead than we allow.
errors.TOO_LATE_TO_CANCEL: Too close to the visit to cancel online. Please contact staff.
errors.PATIENT_TIME_CONFLICT: You already have a visit at that time.
errors.REASON_REQUIRED: Please describe why you're coming in.
errors.REASON_TOO_LONG: The description is longer than 500 characters.
errors.NOT_ON_DUTY: You aren't assigned to this appointment's clinic.
errors.NOT_APPOINTMENT_DAY: Check-in is only possible on the day of the visit.
errors.TOO_EARLY_FOR_NO_SHOW: The visit time hasn't passed yet.
errors.HN_TAKEN: That HN belongs to another patient.
errors.REQUEST_NOT_PENDING: This request was already handled or has expired.
errors.NOT_APPROVED: You can't get a temporary password yet: the request isn't approved, has expired, or was already used.
errors.NO_MATCHING_ACCOUNT: No account matches this request, so it can't be approved.
errors.NOT_PATIENT_ACCOUNT: Only patient accounts can be approved.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a while and try again.
errors.ROOM_CONFLICT: Another doctor already uses this room at that day and session.
errors.TIME_NOT_ON_SLOT: That time doesn't match a slot.
errors.TIME_OUT_OF_SESSION: That time is outside clinic hours.
errors.WEAK_PASSWORD: Use at least 8 characters, and make both fields match.
errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: An account with this email already exists.
errors.NO_PROFILE: This account has no profile. Contact the administrator.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
